# Start Workout

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Starts a workout. The value parameter is the amount of whatever unit you place. For example 200 cal, 10 min, or 1 hr

## Syntax

~~~~text
startWorkout(workout: <#Workout#>, open: <#Boolean (Optional)#>, value: <#String (Optional)#>, unit: <#Workout Unit (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
startWorkout(workout: \, open: , value: "false", unit: 200)
~~~~
